notes: Contract fixture from tests.harness.fake_host_binding (reference walker over FakeUIAutomation trees). Shapes must match live Zig UIA output field-for-field.

structured_observe_hint.with_controls: Use control refs (cN) or names. Do not guess pixels. Screenshot/OCR only if a custom-drawn control is missing.
structured_observe_hint.windows_only: Window list only — UI Automation found no controls. Focus the app and snapshot again, or computer_screenshot for OCR (ref=oN). Do not click guessed x/y.
structured_observe_hint.empty: No structured controls. computer_screenshot then click OCR ref=oN or marked boxes — never guessed coordinates.
